title: Find a shortest path cost
scope: Nonnegative directed small-graph shortest path; numeric cost

items.prompt: Directed edges (from,to,cost)=[['S', 'A', 1], ['A', 'G', 2], ['S', 'B', 2], ['B', 'G', 3], ['S', 'G', 6]]. Find the minimum S→G cost. Edges are nonnegative integers. Implement an algorithm locally if you choose; only your cost answer is checked.
items.solution: Enumerate simple S→G paths: S-A-G=3, S-B-G=5, direct=6. Minimum=3. A path algorithm is not automatically verified.
